name: Daniel Strauss
original_name: ダニエル・ストラウス
source:
The helmsman, entrusted with steering the ship.

He was assigned to the crew for this long-term exploration mission.
He had some personality issues early in the mission, but perhaps after being reprimanded by Liz and the captain,he suddenly became much more well-behaved.

It seems this change has some to do with Aoi and their awkward relationship.....
